sentences.text:
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State.
2.

This bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 0752 of 2023, under Sections - 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Kotwali Nagar,
District- Banda with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place about two years prior to the incident and out of that marriage they have one child.
Only general allegation of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons.

It was stated that applicant was working as a driver but during Covid-19 pandemic period Sabir vs State Of U.P. on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57674430/
1 he could not get any job, due to which his financial condition was not well and deceased has committed suicide due to that reason.

entities.text: Covid-19 pandemic period Sabir vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In postmortem report, except ligature mark no other injury has been shown on the body of deceased and cause of death is ante-mortem hanging.
The child of applicant and deceased is being looked after by the parents of applicant.
Applicant is languishing in jail since 03.10.2023 and that trial of the case would take sufficient long time.
Lastly, it was stated that in case applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has suffered death due to hanging within seven years of her marriage and there are allegations that she was harassed by the applicant and his family members on account of dowry demand.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.

6. The bail application is allowed.
7. Let the applicant - Sabir involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii.
The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
8. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.
